data.body: **P2 — Synchronize shutdown with late external completions.** This drains `pending` only once, but `onOperationChange` can run concurrently with or after `onInvocationEnd`. A terminal wait, invoke, chained invoke, or callback received while `forceFlush()` awaits is queued after this loop and never processed before the per-invocation plugin is discarded, delaying the completion span until redelivery or losing it entirely. Serialize pending processing with shutdown, re-drain after flushing, and make change hooks arriving during shutdown export and flush their completions. Apply the same fix to `InvocationOtelPlugin` and add a test that blocks `forceFlush()` while delivering an update.
